noc_probe_api.h

Read the Network-on-Chip (NoC) probe identity and its error logger.

The calls without a base address use the platform probe base and return -ENOSYS when that base is missing or zero. A zero base_address on a *_with_base call returns -EINVAL.

noc_probe_api_error_is_valid
int32_t noc_probe_api_error_is_valid(
bool 
*
valid
)

Report whether the error logger has a latched error.

Parameters
valid
bool*

Set true when the valid bit is set. Must be non-NULL.

Returns

0 on success. -ENOSYS when the platform base is missing or zero. -EINVAL when valid is NULL.

noc_probe_api_error_read
int32_t noc_probe_api_error_read(
socfpga_noc_probe_error_log_t 
*
log
)

Copy the latched error-log words into log. Does not clear the latch.

Parameters
log
socfpga_noc_probe_error_log_t*

Receives errlog0, errlog1, and errlog3 through errlog7. Must be non-NULL.

Returns

0 on success. -ENOSYS when the platform base is missing or zero. -EINVAL when log is NULL.

noc_probe_api_error_is_valid_with_base
int32_t noc_probe_api_error_is_valid_with_base(
uint32_t 
base_address,
bool 
*
valid
)

Same check as noc_probe_api_error_is_valid(), at base_address.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

Probe MMIO base. Zero is rejected.

valid
bool*

Set true when the valid bit is set. Must be non-NULL.

Returns

0 on success. -EINVAL when base_address is 0 or valid is NULL.

noc_probe_api_error_read_with_base
int32_t noc_probe_api_error_read_with_base(
uint32_t 
base_address,
socfpga_noc_probe_error_log_t 
*
log
)

Same copy as noc_probe_api_error_read(), at base_address.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

Probe MMIO base. Zero is rejected.

log
socfpga_noc_probe_error_log_t*

Receives the latched error words. Must be non-NULL.

Returns

0 on success. -EINVAL when base_address is 0 or log is NULL.

noc_probe_api_read_id
int32_t noc_probe_api_read_id(
uint32_t 
*
core_id
)

Read the probe core identification register.

Parameters
core_id
uint32_t*

Receives the ID. Must be non-NULL.

Returns

0 on success. -ENOSYS when the platform base is missing or zero. -EINVAL when core_id is NULL.

noc_probe_api_error_logger_enable
int32_t noc_probe_api_error_logger_enable(
bool 
enable
)

Enable or disable the error logger.

Parameters
enable
bool

true writes 1 to the fault-enable bit. false writes 0.

Returns

0 on success. -ENOSYS when the platform base is missing or zero.

noc_probe_api_error_clear
int32_t noc_probe_api_error_clear(
void
)

Clear the latched error-valid bit.

Returns

0 on success. -ENOSYS when the platform base is missing or zero.

Same read as noc_probe_api_read_id(), at base_address.

uint32_t

uint32_t*

0 on success. -EINVAL when base_address is 0 or core_id is NULL.

noc_probe_api_error_logger_enable_with_base
int32_t noc_probe_api_error_logger_enable_with_base(
uint32_t 
base_address,
bool 
enable
)

uint32_t
